ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: French Food for Thought When one thinks of French culture, one of the first things that comes to mind is French food. In this course, we will look at a history of French food, the development of various types of cuisine in the country, the history of food institutions like restaurants, and the exporting of French food as a cultural product. We will also look at contemporary discussions about new approaches to thinking about gastronomy, including "nouvelle cuisine," fusion cuisine, and molecular gastronomy. All readings and discussions in English.
